/** Independent verifier: expected R01-R60 frozen at 8d1f527, no product-derived oracle. */

import {reconstructCalculation} from '../../src/domain/exact-money.ts';
import {createF1Issuer,encodeF1Fields} from '../../src/infrastructure/postgres/f1-codec.ts';
import {createF2Issuer} from '../../src/infrastructure/postgres/f2-codec.ts';
import {issueTrustedContext} from '../../src/application/trusted-context.ts';
import {postgresF1Binding} from '../../src/infrastructure/postgres/transaction.ts';
import {canonicalCommercial} from '../../src/domain/commercial-progress.ts';
import {verifyAuth} from '../../src/application/verified-auth.ts';
import type {ObligationCommand} from '../../src/infrastructure/postgres/h3-obligation-adapter.ts';
let h:Awaited<ReturnType<typeof isolatedObligation>>;
type F=Awaited<ReturnType<typeof obligationFixture>>;
const tables=['b05_payment_policies','b05_payment_schedules','b05_schedule_revisions','b05_expected_payments','b05_obligation_adjustments','b05_obligation_operations','b05_obligation_history'];
async function snapshot(target=h){const d:Record<string,unknown>={};for(const t of tables){d[t]=(await target.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') d from crm_private.${t} x`))[0]!.d;}return d;}
async function apply(q:ObligationCommand){return h.obligations.apply(await h.auth(),write,q);}
async function readq(q:ObligationCommand){return h.obligations.read(await h.auth(),read,q.bookingId,q.scheduleId!);}
async function negative(q:ObligationCommand,raw=false){const old=await snapshot();await assert.rejects(raw?rawApply(q):apply(q));assert.deepEqual(await snapshot(),old);}
async function rawApply(input:unknown,scope=h.scope,bad=false){const auth=await h.auth();return h.runtime.begin(async tx=>{
 const row=(await tx`select actor_id::text,admin_scope,access_generation::text,epoch_id::text from crm_api.f2_lookup(${auth.subject}::uuid,${auth.sessionId!}::uuid)`)[0]!,binding=await postgresF1Binding(tx),identity={actorId:row.actor_id,scope:row.admin_scope,sessionId:auth.sessionId!,accessGeneration:row.access_generation,epochId:row.epoch_id};
 const q=encodeF1Fields(['CRM-H3-OBLIGATION1',canonicalCommercial(input)]),t=createF1Issuer(h.f1)(issueTrustedContext({identityId:'H3002 independent verifier',identityKind:'technical',purpose:'h1-evidence',scope,requestId:uid(),serverTime:new Date().toISOString()}),binding,'C03',q,{resource:'evidence',action:'write_evidence'}),a=createF2Issuer(h.f2)(auth,identity,binding,'evidence_write',q,write);
 return tx`select crm_api.obligation_apply(${a.payload},${bad?Buffer.alloc(32):a.mac},${t.payload},${t.mac},${q}) r`;
});}
const computed=(q:ObligationCommand)=>({...q,computed:determineSchedule(q.policy!,q.definition!)});
async function amend(f:F,edit:(q:ObligationCommand)=>ObligationCommand){return f.attest(edit(structuredClone(f.q)));}
async function amounts(q:ObligationCommand){return (await readq(q))!.current.snapshot.parts.map(p=>p.amount);}
async function adjust(f:F,amount='0.00',due:Due={kind:'civil',date:'2026-10-15'},revision=1):Promise<ObligationCommand>{return f.attest({action:'adjust',operationId:uid(),bookingId:f.q.bookingId,policyId:f.q.policyId,scheduleId:f.q.scheduleId,scope:f.q.scope,scopeId:f.q.scopeId,expectedRevision:revision,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC determined correction',reason:'SYNTHETIC authorized cause; not a refund',at:f.q.at,evidenceId:uid(),slot:'initial',amount,due});}
async function inventory(target=h){return {
 tables:await target.observer`select c.oid,c.relname,c.relowner,c.relacl::text,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname in ('crm_private','crm_api','crm_f1','crm_f2') and c.relkind in ('r','p','v','S') order by c.oid`,
 funcs:await target.observer`select p.oid,p.proowner,p.proacl::text,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) def from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('crm_private','crm_api','crm_f1','crm_f2') order by p.oid`,
 policies:await target.observer`select oid,polname,polrelid,polroles::text,pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid) qual,pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid) ck from pg_policy order by oid`,
 triggers:await target.observer`select oid,pg_get_triggerdef(oid) def from pg_trigger order by oid`,
 roles:await target.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,rolbypassrls from pg_roles order by rolname`
};}
async function priorData(target=h){const out:Record<string,unknown>={};for(const {tablename:t} of await target.observer`select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='crm_private' and tablename not like 'b05_%' order by tablename`)out[t]=(await target.observer.unsafe(`select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by to_jsonb(x)::text),'[]') d from crm_private.${t} x`))[0]!.d;return out;}

async function fault(table:string,q:ObligationCommand,deferred=false){
 await h.admin.unsafe("create function crm_private.h3_injected_fault() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$begin raise exception 'H3_INJECTED_FAULT';end$$;");
 await h.admin.unsafe(deferred?`create constraint trigger h3_fault after insert on crm_private.${table} deferrable initially deferred for each row execute function crm_private.h3_injected_fault()`:`create trigger h3_fault before insert on crm_private.${table} for each row execute function crm_private.h3_injected_fault()`);
 try{await negative(q);}finally{await h.admin.unsafe(`drop trigger h3_fault on crm_private.${table}`);await h.admin.unsafe('drop function crm_private.h3_injected_fault()');}
}
test('R39 failure before first write no partial effects',async()=>{const f=await obligationFixture(h);await fault('b05_payment_schedules',f.q);});
test('R40 each material insert failure rolls back dependent unit',async()=>{for(const table of ['b05_payment_schedules','b05_schedule_revisions','b05_expected_payments','b05_obligation_operations','b05_obligation_history']){const f=await obligationFixture(h);await fault(table,f.q);}const f=await obligationFixture(h);await apply(f.q);await fault('b05_obligation_adjustments',await adjust(f));const p=await f.attest({...f.publish,operationId:uid(),expectedRevision:1,policyVersion:2});await fault('b05_payment_policies',p);});

test('R46 owners ACL FORCE RLS no ordinary DML',async()=>{for(const t of tables){for(const role of ['crm_h0_runtime','anon','authenticated']){const sql=h.connect(role);await assert.rejects(sql.unsafe(`select * from crm_private.${t}`));await assert.rejects(sql.unsafe(`delete from crm_private.${t}`));}const r=(await h.observer`select c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,r.rolname from pg_class c join pg_roles r on r.oid=c.relowner where c.oid=${'crm_private.'+t}::regclass`)[0]!;assert.equal(r.relrowsecurity,true);assert.equal(r.relforcerowsecurity,true);assert.equal(r.rolname,'crm_h0_f2_owner');}const roles=await h.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcanlogin from pg_roles where rolname in ('crm_h0_f2_owner','crm_h0_f2_executor','crm_h0_runtime')`;assert.ok(roles.every(x=>!x.rolsuper&&!x.rolbypassrls));assert.ok(roles.filter(x=>x.rolname!=='crm_h0_runtime').every(x=>!x.rolcanlogin));const fns=await h.observer`select p.prosecdef,p.proconfig::text,p.proowner::regrole::text owner,has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'execute') anonymous from pg_proc p where p.proname in ('obligation_apply','obligation_read')`;assert.equal(fns.length,2);assert.ok(fns.every(x=>x.prosecdef&&x.owner==='crm_h0_f2_executor'&&!x.anonymous&&x.proconfig.includes('pg_catalog, pg_temp')));});

test('R50 H2 fixture upgrade preserves all prior data objects IDs privileges',async()=>{const u=await isolatedObligation('crm_h3_002_upgrade',55672,true);try{const b=await bookingFixture(u);await u.booking.apply(await u.auth(),write,b.q);const old=await priorData(u),i=await inventory(u);await u.migration.unsafe(await readFile(new URL(`../../supabase/migrations/${obligationMigration}`,import.meta.url),'utf8'));assert.deepEqual(await priorData(u),old);const after=await inventory(u);for(const k of ['tables','funcs','policies','triggers'] as const){const ids=new Set(i[k].map(x=>x.oid));assert.deepEqual(Array.from(after[k].filter(x=>ids.has(x.oid))),Array.from(i[k]));}assert.deepEqual(after.roles,i.roles);}finally{await u.close();}});

test('R59 revised current policy does not alter historical application',async()=>{const f=await obligationFixture(h);await apply(f.q);const old=await readq(f.q);const next=await f.attest({...f.publish,operationId:uid(),expectedRevision:1,policyVersion:2,reason:'SYNTHETIC new policy version'});await apply(next);assert.deepEqual(await readq(f.q),old);assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_payment_policies where policy_id=${f.q.policyId}::uuid`)[0]!.n,2);});
test('R60 separate session cannot see partial schedule during uncommitted change',async()=>{const f=await obligationFixture(h),reader=h.connect('crm_h0_migration');let signal!:()=>void,release!:()=>void;const written=new Promise<void>(r=>signal=r),finish=new Promise<void>(r=>release=r);const runtime=h.runtime as unknown as {begin:(fn:(tx:unknown)=>Promise<void>)=>Promise<void>};void runtime;
 const tx=h.migration.begin(async tx=>{await tx`insert into crm_private.b05_payment_schedules values(${f.q.scheduleId!}::uuid,${f.q.bookingId}::uuid,${h.scope},'global',${f.q.bookingId}::uuid,${f.q.policyId}::uuid,1,${h.actorId}::uuid,'SYNTHETIC visibility rollback',clock_timestamp())`;signal();await finish;throw new Error('SYNTHETIC rollback');});await written;try{assert.equal((await reader`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_payment_schedules where schedule_id=${f.q.scheduleId!}::uuid`)[0]!.n,0);}finally{release();await assert.rejects(tx);}await apply(f.q);assert.equal((await reader`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b05_expected_payments where schedule_id=${f.q.scheduleId!}::uuid`)[0]!.n,2);});
